items.html: Kwame Tucker has been included in Bermuda's 2007 World Cup squad as the back-up wicketkeeper to Dean Minors. Tucker hails from a cricket-mad family where everyone has played the game - including his grandmother. He has only featured in one ICC Trophy to date as he missed the 2005 tournament, but spent three months in 2005-06 playing club cricket in Brisbane where he also attended a cricket academy. He likes to open the batting but with the recent success of Minors and Clay Smith at the top of the order he may be made to wait for his next chance.
